Lauren — thanks for flagging. Quick take from GTM ops: console-level billing tags can be used for tagging consumption, but credits are minted at the account level and cannot be programmatically split into multiple separate credit objects today. Workarounds we've used:

- Option A (simple): Issue the microgrant to the parent account, then generate consumption reports segmented by tag. Sprout can internally reassign cost per ledger using those reports.
- Option B (requires finance/legal ok): Issue credit memos / separate zero-dollar invoices per sub-team and apply the equivalent value in manual accounting entries. This is manual and needs an exception to create multiple invoice artifacts for one microgrant.

On the VAT/tax point, Markus — is there a precedent for issuing credits through a partner billing path to avoid VAT? Otherwise we need Sprout to accept a standard invoice (we would zero it with a credit).

If we want to pursue Option B, we should route to Finance + Legal for a short exception. I can draft the SOW language for the microgrant routing.

Ben Carter
Principal, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
